# package bpf

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/l2/bpf"
```

Package bpf is the macOS, FreeBSD, NetBSD and DragonFly backend of l2.Port: a Berkeley Packet Filter device (/dev/bpf\*) attached to one network interface.

Opening a port needs read and write access to a /dev/bpf device: root, or on macOS membership of the access\_bpf group that Wireshark's ChmodBPF helper creates. The device is set to immediate mode, writes complete headers (the source address is the frame's), does not return the frames the host sends, and runs in promiscuous mode only when asked.
